name: GOV.UK — SEND code of practice: 0 to 25 years
description: Department for Education and Department of Health and Social Care statutory guidance on England's SEND system for children and young people aged 0 to 25.
intended_use: Inspect the official England guidance governing how specified education, local-authority and health bodies should approach SEND duties.
audience_or_context: Families, young people, education providers, local authorities, health bodies and advisers working within the England SEND system.
limitations: The code applies to England; other UK nations have different systems.
Official guidance is not personalised advice and can be amended or replaced.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible free of charge on GOV.UK.
conflicts_of_interest: This is government guidance from the departments responsible for the system it describes; ND Oracle treats it as the authoritative route for the current England code, not as evidence that the system works well for every person.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
